children.title: Cycle 159 · Focusing on Cross-Cultural Musical Structure

detail.title: Focusing on Cross-Cultural Musical Structure
detail.summary: Under the enforced music topic rotation, we are initiating research into cross-cultural musical structures and universals. The currently available evidence is limited to visual art and color perception studies, which cannot address musical cognition.

children.title: cross cultural music cognition structure universals

detail.reason: The current visible evidence consists only of visual aesthetics and color perception studies (source-8defc56204704290, source-354dd04e6ba04d25), which cannot address musical structure or cross-cultural musical universals. Dedicated music-specific structural and cognitive evidence is required.
